rates.title: Advantage price gourmet board from 4 days
rates.description:
Alpenhof Gourmet Board

  • Extensive breakfast buffet with fresh and regional products
  • Delicious desserts, hearty salads, fine soups and savoury delicacies at our afternoon buffet
  • In the evening, a 5-course gourmet menu from the Michelin-starred kitchen of our head chef Maximilian Stock
  • Michelin-starred gourmet restaurant – for gourmets looking for something truly extraordinary: Embark on a culinary journey with Maximilian Stock's 6-course gourmet menu, awarded one Michelin star and 4 toques (at an additional cost)

4,000 m² SPA

  • Garden SPA (2,800 m²) with
    • Indoor pool with 16-metre swimming length
    • Heated outdoor panoramic whirlpool
    • 7 different saunas and steam baths
    • Several relaxation rooms
    • Large Alpine garden
    • Wide range of massage and beauty treatments
  • Adults only SPA (1,200 m²) with
    • 20-metre sports pool
    • Event sauna and bio sauna
    • Rooftop whirlpool
    • Invigorating cold water pool
    • Natural relaxation room
    • Panoramic outdoor lounging area

Fit & Vital

  • Panoramic fitness studio
  • Yoga room for your yoga practice, meditation and breathing exercises
  • 160 m² sports hall – a flexible indoor sports area

cancellations:
Less than 7 days before the agreed day of arrival cancellation fee of 90% of the booking price shall be incurred.

Less than 30 days before the agreed day of arrival cancellation fee of 70% of the booking price shall be incurred.

Less than 60 days before the agreed day of arrival cancellation fee of 40% of the booking price shall be incurred.
policies.guarantees: To secure your booking, 30% of the total amount will be charged as a deposit from your credit card.
taxes: Age 0-14: 0.00 EUR per person per night
Age from 15: 2.60 EUR per person per night
pets: We charge 35,00 € per day (no meals included). We ask you to bring your own basket/blanket as well as a muzzle for public transport. Dogs are not permitted in the dining room, in the sports areas and in our relaxation area VITALIS. We reserve the right to charge an eventual cleanup to the bill.

metadata.title: Junior-Suite Enzian North
metadata.description: Cosy lounge/bedroom in a soft, mossy green, Tyrolean spruce wood, premium, CO2-neutral carpet made from 100% recycled yarn, tiled stove, premium box-spring beds, spacious bathroom with shower and bathtub – separate WC, balcony, facing the road

metadata.description: Suite made of Tyrolean pine wood with extra-large living room, sitting area and couch; local oak wood floor; mini fridge; separate bedroom; spacious bathroom with shower and bathtub - separate WC; plenty of storage space; fantastic view of the Hintertux glacier; balcony

metadata.title: Suite Goldstern
metadata.description: Generously dimensioned, welcoming suite in Tyrolean stone pine, native spruce wood flooring, separate lounge and bedroom, additional walk-in wardrobe with lots of storage space, elegant and spacious bathroom with shower and bathtub – separate WC, mini refrigerator; view of the imposing Tux mountains, roof terrace or balcony

metadata.title: Junior-Suite Enzian West
metadata.description: Cosy lounge/bedroom in a soft, mossy green, Tyrolean spruce wood, premium, CO2-neutral carpet made from 100% recycled yarn, tiled stove, premium box-spring beds, spacious bathroom with shower and bathtub – separate WC, balcony, facing the garden with glacier views

metadata.title: Junior-Suite Enzian South
metadata.description: Cosy lounge/bedroom in a soft, mossy green, Tyrolean spruce wood, premium, CO2-neutral carpet made from 100% recycled yarn, tiled stove, premium box-spring beds, spacious bathroom with shower and bathtub – separate WC, balcony, facing the river with mountain views

metadata.title: Suite Margerite
metadata.description: Spacious lounge with separate bedroom in Tyrolean spruce wood, elegant Tyrolean oak flooring, seating corner may be converted into a bunk bed with two premium mattresses, additional walk-in wardrobe with lots of space, tiled stove; spacious bathroom with shower and bathtub – separate WC, balcony, facing the street

metadata.title: Suite Edelweiss Family
metadata.description: Luxurious and spacious family suite made of Tyrolean pine wood; local oak wood flooring; separte children's room with space for up to 4 children (4 full-size beds); separate children's bathroom; master bedroom with adjoining bathroom; spacious living area with lounge and sitting area; mini refrigerator; splendid view of the Hintertux Glacier; balcony

metadata.title: Alpenhof Suite
metadata.description: Luxurious, very generously dimensioned suite in Tyrolean stone pine, native spruce flooring, spacious lounge with sofa, seating corner and open fireplace, separate bedroom, additional walk-in wardrobe with lots of storage space, splendid panorama bathroom with infrared booth, shower and bathtub – separate WC, mini refrigerator; view of the imposing Tux mountains, roof terrace

metadata.title: Room Himmelschlüssel
metadata.description: Generously dimensioned single room in Tyrolean spruce wood, French bed – may also be used as a double bed, spacious bathroom with shower and bathtub – separate WC, roof terrace facing the river with stunning mountain views

metadata.title: Room Bergklee
metadata.description: Cosy single room in Tyrolean spruce wood, French bed – may also be used as a double bed, small yet pleasant bathroom with shower and WC, balcony, facing the street

metadata.title: Natur-Suite
metadata.description: Suite made of Tyrolean Swiss pine with natural fabrics and materials, local oak flooring, spacious living area, comfortable seating area and sofa, separate bedroom, bathroom with shower and bathtub – separate toilet, mini fridge, unique, quiet location with unobstructed views of nature, cosy loggia for relaxing outdoors.

metadata.title: Natur-Suite Family
metadata.description: Exclusive and spacious family suite made of Tyrolean Swiss pine with natural fabrics and materials, local oak flooring, separate children's room for up to 3 children with bunk beds and single beds, separate children's bathroom, master bedroom with adjoining bathroom, living area for the whole family to relax in, mini fridge, particularly quiet location with magnificent views of the countryside, cosy loggia for relaxing outdoors.
